Crime & Law · India

India arrests over 200 linked to Pakistan terror network before Independence Day

Indian authorities announced the dismantling of the Pakistan-based Shahzad Bhatti Network, arresting over 200 operatives across 14 states. The operation, described as a terror plot foiled ahead of Independence Day, was detailed by Union Home Minister Amit Shah. The arrests were made in states including Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, and Delhi. The network is alleged to be ISI-backed.
